//: Localiza el host del shadow root por id en el documento y en el frame del mapa.

steps.eval: const findNode = (rx) => [...document.querySelectorAll('.x-tree-node-text')].find((el) => rx.test(el.textContent.trim())); const apps = findNode(/^aplicaciones$/i); if (apps) { let c = apps; for (let i = 0; i < 6 && c; i += 1) { if (c.querySelector && c.querySelector('.x-tree-expander')) break; c = c.parentElement; } const ex = c ? c.querySelector('.x-tree-expander') : null; (ex || apps).click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)); } const mapa = findNode(/^mapas?$/i); if (!mapa) return { error: 'no Mapas' }; mapa.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 9000)); return { ready: true };

const h = document.getElementById('centrality-v10-host'); const out = { top: Boolean(h) }; if (h) { const sh = h.shadowRoot; out.shadowHijos = sh ? sh.childNodes.length : null; out.topbar = Boolean(sh && sh.querySelector('.topbar')); out.botones = sh ? sh.querySelectorAll('button').length : null; out.chips = sh ? sh.querySelectorAll('button.chip').length : null; } return out;

steps.inFrame: const h = document.getElementById('centrality-v10-host'); const out = { wmc: Boolean(h) }; if (h) { const sh = h.shadowRoot; out.shadowHijos = sh ? sh.childNodes.length : null; out.topbar = Boolean(sh && sh.querySelector('.topbar')); out.botones = sh ? sh.querySelectorAll('button').length : null; } return out;
